from sklearn.neighbors import NearestNeighbors #finds nearest neighbors.

neighbors = NearestNeighbors(n_neighbors=5) #For every point, find its 5 nearest neighbors. Why 5? Because usually: \text{min_samples} = 5
                                             #So we match n_neighbors with min_samples.
neighbors_fit = neighbors.fit(energy_scaled) #We train the neighbor model on our data.Now it knows where all points are located
distances, indices = neighbors_fit.kneighbors(energy_scaled) #For each point, it calculates: Distance to its 5 nearest neighbors
                                                              #Index positions of those neighbors

distances = np.sort(distances[:,4])  #Take the distance to the 5th nearest neighbor for every point. Sort them from smallest to largest.

plt.plot(distances)
plt.title("K-distance Graph")
plt.show()

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.cluster.hierarchy import dendrogram, linkage
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

# Load ORIGINAL data
df_original = pd.read_csv("W_Sample.csv")

# --- Step 1: Prepare Data ---
# Select Energy, Humidity, Temp, CO2 columns (Original values)
features = [
    'Total_Energy_Consumption',
    'Room1_Humidity', 'Room1_Temperature', 'Room1_CO2',
    'Room2_Humidity', 'Room2_Temperature', 'Room2_CO2',
    'Room3_Humidity', 'Room3_Temperature', 'Room3_ CO2',
    'Room4_Humidity', 'Room4_Temperature', 'Room4_CO2',
    'Room5_Humidity', 'Room5_Temperature', 'Room5_CO2',
    'Room6_Humidity', 'Room6_Temperature', 'Room6_CO2',
    'Room7_Humidity', 'Room7_Temperature', 'Room7_ CO2',
    'Room8_Humidity', 'Room8_Temperature', 'Room8_CO2'
]

# Extract data
X = df_original[features]

# Standardize values (Important because units are different: kWh, %, °C, ppm)
scaler = StandardScaler()
X_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X)

# --- Step 2: Create Hierarchical Model ---
# method='ward' is best for numerical data
Z = linkage(X_scaled, method='ward')

# --- Step 3: Plot Dendrogram ---
plt.figure(figsize=(18, 8))
dendrogram(Z, leaf_rotation=90, leaf_font_size=10)

plt.title('Dendrogram - Hierarchical Clustering (Original Energy Data)', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Data Points (Households/Readings)', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Euclidean Distance (Dissimilarity)', fontsize=14)
plt.show()

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.cluster.hierarchy import dendrogram, linkage
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

# Load Original Data
df_original = pd.read_csv("W_Sample.csv")

# Use ONLY Energy Column
X = df_original[['Total_Energy_Consumption']]

# Standardize
scaler = StandardScaler()
X_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X)

# Create Linkage
Z = linkage(X_scaled, method='ward')

# --- Plot with Truncation ---
# This will fix the error
plt.figure(figsize=(15, 8))
dendrogram(Z, truncate_mode='level', p=5, leaf_rotation=90, leaf_font_size=10)

plt.title('Dendrogram Based ONLY on Total Energy Consumption', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Data Points', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Distance', fontsize=14)
plt.show()

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
from scipy.cluster.hierarchy import dendrogram, linkage

# --- 1. Load and Prepare Data ---
# Use Original Data
df_original = pd.read_csv("W_Sample.csv")

# Select all features (Energy, Temp, Humidity, CO2)
features = [col for col in df_original.columns if col not in ['Room_Rec_AC', 'Room_Sqr_AC', 'Room_Comp_AC'] 
            and '(On/Off)' not in col]

X = df_original[features]

# Standardize (Very Important for PCA)
scaler = StandardScaler()
X_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X)

# --- 2. Apply PCA ---
# Reduce to 2 dimensions so we can visualize and cluster
pca = PCA(n_components=2)
X_pca = pca.fit_transform(X_scaled)

print(f"✅ Data reduced from {X.shape[1]} columns to {X_pca.shape[1]} Components.")

# --- 3. Apply Hierarchical Clustering on PCA results ---
Z = linkage(X_pca, method='ward')

# --- 4. Plot Dendrogram ---
plt.figure(figsize=(15, 8))
dendrogram(Z, truncate_mode='level', p=5, leaf_rotation=90, leaf_font_size=10)

plt.title('Dendrogram based on PCA Results (All Features Combined)', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Data Points')
plt.ylabel('Distance')
plt.show()

✅ Data reduced from 25 columns to 2 Components.

from scipy.cluster.hierarchy import fcluster

# Decide number of clusters (e.g., 6)
clusters = fcluster(Z, t=6, criterion='maxclust')

# Plot
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 8))
plt.scatter(X_pca[:, 0], X_pca[:, 1], c=clusters, cmap='tab10', s=50)

plt.title('Visualization of Clusters using PCA', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Principal Component 1')
plt.ylabel('Principal Component 2')
plt.colorbar(label='Cluster Label')
plt.show()

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.cluster.hierarchy import linkage, fcluster
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA

# Load Data
df_original = pd.read_csv("W_Sample.csv")

# Select ALL numerical features
features = [
    'Total_Energy_Consumption',
    'Room1_Humidity', 'Room1_Temperature', 'Room1_CO2',
    'Room2_Humidity', 'Room2_Temperature', 'Room2_CO2',
    'Room3_Humidity', 'Room3_Temperature', 'Room3_ CO2',
    'Room4_Humidity', 'Room4_Temperature', 'Room4_CO2',
    'Room5_Humidity', 'Room5_Temperature', 'Room5_CO2',
    'Room6_Humidity', 'Room6_Temperature', 'Room6_CO2',
    'Room7_Humidity', 'Room7_Temperature', 'Room7_ CO2',
    'Room8_Humidity', 'Room8_Temperature', 'Room8_CO2'
]

X = df_original[features]

# Standardize
scaler = StandardScaler()
X_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X)

# Apply PCA
pca = PCA(n_components=2)
X_pca = pca.fit_transform(X_scaled)

# Create Clusters (Based on your dendrogram, 4 clusters is perfect)
Z = linkage(X_pca, method='ward')
df_original['Cluster'] = fcluster(Z, t=4, criterion='maxclust')

# --- Visualize ---
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
scatter = plt.scatter(X_pca[:, 0], X_pca[:, 1], c=df_original['Cluster'], cmap='tab10', s=50)

plt.title('Energy Consumption Clusters (Based on ALL Features)', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('PCA Component 1 (Main Pattern)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('PCA Component 2 (Secondary Pattern)', fontsize=12)
plt.legend(handles=scatter.legend_elements()[0], labels=['Cluster 1', 'Cluster 2', 'Cluster 3', 'Cluster 4'], title="Groups")
plt.grid(True)
plt.show()

# --- Show Average Values for each Cluster ---
print("\n--- Average Values for Each Cluster ---")
print(df_original.groupby('Cluster')[['Total_Energy_Consumption', 'Room1_Temperature', 'Room1_Humidity']].mean())
